outcome: PPIUCD complication rate (including spontaneous ejection, infection, pregnancy with IUCD in situ)
cohort: Women who consented to PPIUCD insertion after giving birth, either vaginally or via lower segment cesarean surgery.
finding: PPIUCD insertion was found to be a well-recognized, safe, and efficient long-acting reversible contraceptive technique, with most women continuing use and rare negative outcomes such as expulsion, infection, or pregnancy.
